name: donation-hero
title: Donation hero
description: A nonprofit opening with the gift on the first screen: one-off or monthly, four amounts, your own, a campaign meter and what each gift pays for.
docs: All money is in minor units, hundredths of the currency's unit, like CurrencyInput and most payment APIs: pass 2500 for 25.00. impactFor(amount, frequency) returns the end of a sentence ("pays for a week of meals") that is written over the picture and changes with every choice. onDonate({ amount, frequency, currency }) is where your checkout starts; return a promise and the button shows it is busy until it settles. impactFor and onDonate are functions, so use the hero inside a Client Component.
